records.name: 3rd and Norris Playground Friends
records.summary: The City lists this as the Friends group for the playground at 3rd and Norris. We have not yet found its own website or a public contact.

first_step.how: Email Parks and Recreation's stewardship office (pprstewardship@phila.gov) and ask to be connected with this Friends group

records.notes: No website, social page or public contact found for this group. Name and address come from the City Friends group list. No contact found for the group itself, so the first step uses the stewardship office. Open to public is assumed for a City listed park Friends group, not confirmed. The three WebSearch calls went to other groups.

records.name: Community Learning Farm at 8th and Poplar
records.summary: A food farm on Eighth Street beside East Poplar Playground, run by the Federation of Neighborhood Centers. It grows fresh produce and shares it with neighborhoods around the city.
records.what_you_do: Help out on farm workdays, which the Philadelphia Orchard Project has reported on. The farm's own schedule was not found, so ask before you come.

first_step.how: Ask the Philadelphia Orchard Project (phillyorchards.org) when the next workday is at the 8th and Poplar farm

records.notes: Operated by the Federation of Neighborhood Centers (FNC Community Learning Farms). Its website, fncphilly.org, did not resolve on two tries (DNS error), so no page from the farm itself was read. Newest dated evidence is a Philadelphia Orchard Project post of December 12, 2024 that mentions a workday at the farm. Older sources (a 2018 profile and a 2015 feature) describe a farmstand, garden plots and youth programs, but they are too old to state as current. Older coverage calls the site Teens 4 Good Farm. A volunteer listing from May 2024 is marked expired. The first step is a Philadelphia Orchard Project contact, not a group contact.

records.name: Friends of Bainbridge Green
records.summary: Neighbors who look after Bainbridge Green in Queen Village with the Queen Village Neighbors Association. They weed, plant, sweep, and paint the green, often on City Love Your Park days.
records.what_you_do: Join a cleanup or planting day, such as the Love Your Park day on Sunday, November 15, 2026. Email the group to be added to the volunteer list.

schedule.text: Cleanup and planting days fall on Love Your Park dates, for example Saturday, May 16, 2026, and Sunday, November 15, 2026. The group's own page does not give a schedule.

cost.text: Free to volunteer. No fees listed.

first_step.how: Email FOBGVolunteers@gmail.com to be added to the volunteer list for the next cleanup
first_step.basis: Volunteer days are announced publicly, and anyone can ask by email to be added to the list.

records.notes: The group's own page has no dates. The QVNA events calendar lists two Friends of Bainbridge Green days: a Love Your Park cleanup on May 16, 2026 (past) and one on November 15, 2026 (upcoming). The group's Facebook group exists but no URL is published on the page, so it is not recorded. Image file names with 2025 dates were not used as evidence.

records.name: Friends of Bardascino Park
records.summary: Neighbors who have looked after Giuseppe Bardascino Park at 10th and Carpenter since 1991. They have helped with renovations and tree and bench replacements, and they organize cleanups.
records.what_you_do: Give time to cleanups, which the group runs from November through April, or donate. Email the group to ask how to help.

schedule.text: Cleanups run from November through April. The group has not posted set days or times.

cost.text: Free to volunteer. Donations are accepted, but no membership fee is listed.

first_step.how: Email bardparkfriends@gmail.com to ask when the next cleanup is and how to sign up
first_step.basis: The group invites people to give time or money and lists an email address for volunteers.

records.notes: Newest dated item on the group's site is the December 2, 2020 unveiling of a park history sign. No dated item from 2021 or later was found on the site, so status is dormant and the last seen date shows on the listing. The cleanup schedule (November to April) is undated. The city-funded summer maintenance attendant (May to October) is a City job, not the group's. A separate bocce league email is on the site and is not recorded.

records.name: Friends of Barkan Park
records.summary: The City lists this as the Friends group for Ben Barkan Park at 4998 Spruce St. We have not yet found its own website or a public contact.

first_step.how: Email Parks and Recreation's stewardship office (pprstewardship@phila.gov) and ask to be connected with this Friends group

records.notes: No website or public contact found. Not searched: the three WebSearch calls went to groups with no website where a search was most likely to help. No contact found for the group itself, so the first step uses the stewardship office. Open to public is assumed for a City listed park Friends group, not confirmed.

records.name: Friends of Beck Park
records.summary: Neighbors in the Queen Village Neighbors Association who clean up and beautify Beck Park. They join the City's Love Your Park cleanups and meet about every two months.
records.what_you_do: Take part in park cleanups and beautification projects, and come to the group's meetings. The group recruits through its Facebook group.

schedule.text: Meets about every two months, and more often during special projects. Days and times were not published.

first_step.how: Visit the QVNA volunteer page (qvna.org/volunteer) or the Friends of Beck Park Facebook group and ask about the next cleanup or meeting

records.notes: The group's page shows only a 2025 copyright line, which is not evidence. Status is probably_active because the page works but has no dates. No month is recorded. The group is a member of the Queen Village Neighbors Association. The association's general email is not recorded as the group's contact. The QVNA events calendar for May to December 2026 lists no Beck Park events.

records.name: Belmont Plateau Trails Alliance
records.summary: A group that works with the City and the Fairmount Park Conservancy to look after the trails on Belmont Plateau in West Fairmount Park.
records.what_you_do: Works on the trail system alongside the City and the Conservancy. The site does not say how members of the public can help.

first_step.how: Email Parks and Recreation's stewardship office (pprstewardship@phila.gov) and ask to be connected with this Friends group

records.notes: The site loads but shows no dated item. Its only date is a 2025 copyright line, which is not evidence. Its /events and /news paths returned not found. No volunteer details or public contact were found on the site, so the first step uses the stewardship office. Status is probably_active because the page works but has no dates, so no month is recorded. Open to public reflects that the trails are public; membership rules were not found.

records.name: Parkway Council
records.summary: A not-for-profit that works to turn the Benjamin Franklin Parkway into a park for everyone. It runs summer programs in Maja Park and a yearly art installation on the Parkway.
records.what_you_do: Go to the council's events on the Parkway, such as the summer evening programs in Maja Park. The site lists no volunteer sign-up.

schedule.text: Summer evening programs in Maja Park, such as concerts, run in August and September. The site does not list set weekly days.

first_step.how: Go to a summer program in Maja Park, or email info@parkwaycouncil.org to ask how to get involved

records.notes: The City list gives the web address as www.parwaycouncil.org. We used www.parkwaycouncil.org, which is the group's own site and matches its email domain. Please check the City list entry. Most homepage items give only a month. The newest dated item is a September 2026 notice about the Academy of Natural Sciences museum closure. Maja Park program dates are given as August and September without a year. The address is a mailing address, c/o Friends Select School.

records.name: Friends of Benson Park
records.summary: Neighbors who help keep Benson Park clean, safe, and green. They host events such as movie nights, picnics, and cookouts, and they meet every month.
records.what_you_do: Come to a monthly meeting, help with park upkeep, and join community events such as movie nights and picnics.

schedule.text: Monthly meeting on the last Thursday in the park during warm months, and an online meeting by Zoom in winter. A recent online meeting ran 6 to 7 pm.

cost.text: No membership fee listed. Donations are accepted.

first_step.how: Come to the next monthly meeting (anyone may attend), or email bensonpark1980@gmail.com to join the Friends group
first_step.basis: Anyone may attend the monthly meetings, and the group gives an email address to join.

records.notes: The group's own site is current: it lists an August 22, 2026 children's event and an August 18, 2026 online meeting. The site gives the address as 1445 North Lawrence Street, but the City list gives 1444 N 4th St. The group's own address is recorded here. The site also shows a donation tag, which is not recorded.

records.name: Friends of Boone Park
records.summary: The City lists this as the Friends group for Boone Park at 4200 Boone St. The only online page we found is a Facebook group, and we have not confirmed its activities.

first_step.how: Email Parks and Recreation's stewardship office (pprstewardship@phila.gov) and ask to be connected with this Friends group

records.notes: The only web presence is a Facebook group. Per our rules it was not read, and no facts were taken from it. No contact found for the group itself, so the first step uses the stewardship office. Open to public is assumed for a City listed park Friends group, not confirmed.

records.name: Friends of Riverfront North at Borski Park
records.summary: Neighbors who work with Riverfront North Partnership to help keep Robert A. Borski Jr. Park safe and welcoming. The partnership also lists fitness and bike events at the park.
records.what_you_do: Join the Friends by email, then come to the park's free events this fall, such as the Tuesday and Sunday fitness sessions.

schedule.text: Park events this fall fall on Tuesdays and Sundays. Friends meeting dates were not published.

cost.text: Programs are described as free. Donations are welcome.

first_step.how: Email friends@riverfrontnorth.org to become a Friend of Borski Park, then come to a Tuesday or Sunday session at the park
first_step.basis: The group says to join by email, and the park sessions are open to the public.

records.notes: The Friends page has no dates and gives no meeting dates, though it links to past minutes. The activity evidence is the parent group's events calendar, Riverfront North Partnership, which lists October and November 2026 sessions at Borski Park. That calendar does not name the Friends group. The phone and social links are the partnership's, and the partnership office is at 3460 N Delaware Ave, Suite 306. The Silver Sneakers and All In Athletics sessions are the partnership's programs.

records.name: Brewerytown Garden
records.summary: A community garden at 27th and Master streets. Gardeners grow food, the garden runs a farm stand and a composting program, and it holds Sunday events.
records.what_you_do: Gardeners share the season's work, at least about half a day a month per household. Plots are full for 2026, and a wait list is open to residents of zip code 19121 and nearby Fairmount.

schedule.text: Sunday events are listed on the garden's site. Event times were not found.

first_step.how: Put your name on the plot wait list if you live in zip code 19121 or nearby Fairmount (the list is reviewed once a year, when plots are assigned)
first_step.basis: Plots are full and the wait list runs for several seasons, so the way in is a long wait.

records.notes: The join page says the garden is full for the 2026 season and that the wait list has over 160 households, with a review in 2027. No month appears on any event, so no last_sign_of_life month is recorded and status is probably_active. The Sunday events page had no dated items. The garden's email on its site is an obfuscated link we could not read, so the email listed here comes from the City list. Gardening plots are limited to residents, so open to is residents.

records.name: Friends of Buist Park
records.summary: The City lists this as the Friends group for Buist Park at 2528 Hobson St. We found no website or public contact for it yet.

first_step.how: Email Parks and Recreation's stewardship office (pprstewardship@phila.gov) and ask to be connected with this Friends group

records.notes: A web search for the group found no page for it. The closest hit was Friends of Elmwood Park, a different park at 71st and Buist Avenue, listed under leads_only and not matched here. No contact found for the group itself, so the first step uses the stewardship office. Open to public is assumed for a City listed park Friends group, not confirmed.

records.name: Friends of the Bulldog Park
records.summary: The City lists this as the Friends group for the Bulldog Park, also called Reliance Triangle, at 2501 Pennsylvania Ave. We could not read its website, so its activities are not yet confirmed.

first_step.how: Email Parks and Recreation's stewardship office (pprstewardship@phila.gov) and ask to be connected with this Friends group

records.notes: The group's website returned no readable text on two tries (with and without www), so it is recorded as unknown and the website is the City list's address. No contact found for the group itself, so the first step uses the stewardship office. Open to public is assumed for a City listed park Friends group, not confirmed. A recheck may help.

records.name: Friends of Ryerss at Burholme
records.summary: A volunteer group that supports the Ryerss Museum and Library, a historic mansion in Burholme Park. The museum is free to visit and open on weekends.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer with the Friends to help the museum and library. Visit on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday between 10 am and 4 pm to ask how to join.

schedule.text: The museum is open Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays from 10 am to 4 pm. Friends meeting times were not found.

cost.text: Museum admission is free. Donations are welcome.

first_step.how: Visit the museum on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday between 10 am and 4 pm and ask the staff how to join the Friends
first_step.basis: The museum is free and open on weekends, but the Friends' way to join is not published.

records.notes: No website of the group's own was found. The contacts listed are the museum's, not the Friends group's. The museum site has no Friends details or events. The February 13, 2026 Northeast Times article returned a 403 to our fetch, so it is cited by its web address and the date comes from that address only. No facts were recorded from the article's text. An undated Historical Society of Pennsylvania catalog record and an older profile use the name The Friends of Burholme, which may be this same group, not confirmed. The museum site's Twitter link points to TikTok and is not recorded.

leads_only.name: Friends of Elmwood Park
leads_only.note: Named in a search for Friends of Buist Park. A different park at 71st and Buist Avenue. Not checked.

blocked.note: Fetch refused; the Ryerss record uses only the date in the web address

notes: 15 groups in batch, 15 records, all verdict publish. Status counts: active 5 (Bainbridge, Benson, Borski, Parkway, Ryerss), probably_active 4 (Community Learning Farm, Beck, Belmont, Brewerytown), dormant 1 (Bardascino), unknown 5 (3rd and Norris, Barkan, Boone, Bulldog, Buist). Probably_active records with no dated month (Beck, Belmont, Brewerytown) have last_sign_of_life null because no month was shown. The City's Friends list page at phila.gov (park-friends-group-list) showed none of the 15 groups, so it did not add contacts. WebSearch: 3 of 3 used (Community Learning Farm, Friends of Ryerss, Friends of Buist Park). The Beck Park QVNA page came up as an incidental search hit and was then fetched. Boone Park's only web presence is Facebook, which was not read. Belmont's /events and /news paths returned not found. Parkway Council's City list URL (parwaycouncil.org) differs from the group's own site (parkwaycouncil.org). Benson Park's own address differs from the City list. The farm's operator site did not resolve. Fetches: about 25 attempted, 5 failed or returned no text. Budget was not exhausted.
